historicalNominalContract.text: | `LibraProductFactEvidence` | `evidenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-evidence@1",libraRunId,factKind,factRevision,sourceBasisKind,sourceBasisDigest,commitPayloadDigest,eventFenceDigest}))`。`fact_json`保存完整typed Result；`fact_digest=DomainFactEnvelope.factDigest`；`result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(完整typed Result))`且逐字节等于同marker的Event Result。Media Cast Result逐项复制Draft relation并以当前Run的subjectId校验；Product Metadata Result逐项复制Draft、同Run Media Cast Fact引用与Manifest digest，Owner row额外冻结完整Verified Artifact Manifest。Owner row、Source refs、Manifest内显式Artifact Verification Result refs、marker与Result足以历史重建完整Commit Payload；不得回读Provider、People、later Foundation Result或扫描无关Result补字段 |
